seller.title: Become a seller
seller.intro: Every account can bid. To publish your own auctions, apply for a seller profile: send your store details and documents and an administrator reviews them.
seller.isSellerBody: Your account can publish auctions. Open the seller portal to manage your lots.
seller.pendingBody: An administrator is reviewing your documents. You'll get a notification and an email as soon as there is a decision. You keep bidding as usual meanwhile.
seller.rejectedTitle: Your last application was not approved
seller.reapply: Correct your details below and apply again.
seller.documentsHint: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB. Documents are private: only you and the eRecycleHub team can open them.
seller.sent: Application sent. We'll let you know once it is reviewed.
seller.docsMissing: Attach your commercial registration and identity documents.
